props.gloss_en: and likewise a courtyard surrounded by a portico: if there are four amot beneath [the portico roof], invalid
roofing over a portico that has posts -- valid
without posts, Abaye: valid
and Rava: invalid
Abaye: valid -- we say the edge of the roof descends and seals
Rava: invalid -- we do not say the edge of the roof descends and seals
(entertained) Abaye and Rava dispute as Rav and Shmuel dispute over a portico in a field
a portico in a field: Rav -- one may carry in all of it, for we say the edge of the roof descends and seals
Shmuel -- one may carry in it only within four amot, for we do not say the edge of the roof descends and seals
on Shmuel's view no one disputes [the sukkah is invalid -- no pi tikra]
where they dispute is on Rav's view
Abaye is like Rav
and Rava can tell you: Rav said it only there, where the partitions were made for the portico; here, where they were not made for this [the sukkah] -- no
Pumbedita version: roofing a portico without posts -- all agree it is invalid
Pumbedita version: with posts, Rava -- invalid; we do not say lavud
Pumbedita version: Abaye -- valid; we say lavud [joins the posts]
Pumbedita version: Rava -- we do not say lavud
and the halakha follows the first version (the Sura version of the portico dispute)
Rav Kahana was roofing [a sukkah] over a portico without posts
the stam's alternative: [what Rav Kahana showed was] a post visible from outside and level inside
[as was stated:] visible from outside and level inside -- it is judged as a side-post (lechi)
and a lechi is the same as posts
the Tosefta: psal extending from the sukkah is judged as the sukkah
Ulla: reeds extending behind the sukkah
Rabba and Rav Yosef: reeds extending in front of the sukkah, with one wall drawn along with them -- lest you say it lacks the sukkah minimum, it teaches us [it is valid]
R' Yochanan: it is needed only for a sukkah whose majority has more shade than sun and minority more sun than shade -- lest you say it is invalidated by that bit, it teaches us [it is not]
and what is 'extending'? extending out of the sukkah's validity
R' Oshaya: it is needed only for unfit sekhakh of less than three [tefachim] in a small sukkah
and what is 'extending'? extending out of the law of sukkah
R' Abba: this [unfit sekhakh under three] combines and one may sleep under it
R' Abba: and that [avir under three] combines and one may not sleep under it
